trello.name: Implement queue depth alerts for worker fleets
trello.desc: Kofi will implement alerts on queue depth for all worker fleets including payment workers. The alert thresholds are warning at 1,000 jobs and paging at 5,000 jobs. This will help detect queue backlogs early to prevent service degradation.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic
trello.desc: Marta will fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py to implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap retries, and send failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of re-enqueuing at the front. She will also add tests simulating processor 503 errors to cover this logic.

trello.name: Increase and split database connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi will increase the database connection pool from 20 to 100 and separate the worker and API connection pools in the configuration file to prevent workers from exhausting the API's pool. This combined change will improve system stability during load spikes.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya, with Kofi's confirmation, will update the payment incident runbook to replace old Kibana links with new logging links, document the queue drain procedure used in the outage, and verify and update escalation phone numbers to current contacts to avoid delays during incidents.

trello.name: Automate status page updates for checkout errors
trello.desc: Marta will automate the status page updates so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically switches to an investigating status with a template message. This will reduce delays and improve communication during incidents.

trello.name: Draft failover game day plan for payment processor
trello.desc: Kofi will lead drafting a controlled chaos test plan ('Game Day') for the payment processor failover, first in staging then in production during low traffic, including a rollback plan. The draft will be ready for review in two weeks; no execution before approval.

trello.name: Schedule Redis upgrade to version 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi will schedule an upgrade of Redis from version 6.0 to 7.2 with the infrastructure calendar. This requires a planned change window due to config renames and persistence default changes, ensuring a controlled and safe upgrade process.
